Bug_Title: Eq: equals() method defined that doesn’t override equals(Object) (EQ_OTHER_NO_OBJECT)
Bug_Details:
This class defines an equals()
method, that doesn't override the normal equals(Object) method
defined in the base java.lang.Object class.  Instead, it
inherits an equals(Object) method from a superclass.
The class should probably define a boolean equals(Object) method.
 equals() equals(Object) java.lang.Object equals(Object) boolean equals(Object)
Bug_Explanation: The code defines an equals(CustomEquals) method that does not correctly override the equals(Object) method from java.lang.Object. Instead of overriding, it creates a new method with a different signature. This leads to unexpected behavior when objects are compared using the equals method, as it does not adhere to the contract of equals(Object). The correct approach should be to override equals(Object) to ensure polymorphism works as expected.
